name: Cutteridge Residence

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single primary residence with a light gray roof and a compact footprint|A paved driveway leads from the street to the front of the house|A front lawn and a rear lawn occupy the yard|A detached structure with a matching roof sits at the rear of the lot|A public street runs along the front|A second paved way is visible behind the detached structure.

alpha.desc: The front of the residence faces Winchester Ave with a paved driveway, a front lawn, and a sidewalk|The house has a light gray roof|Trees and shrubs sit in the front yard|Neighboring homes occupy adjacent lots on both sides|A back lawn and detached structure is viewed at the rear of the property.

bravo.desc: The left side of the residence shows the side wall, the front lawn, and a wood fence along the rear|The detached rear structure sits behind the house|The paved driveway is visible at the front|Neighboring lots sit close along this side.

charlie.desc: The rear of the property shows a wood fence, a rear lawn, and a detached structure facing a paved way behind the lot|The main house sits in front of the detached structure|Landscaping occupies the rear yard|Neighboring fences and yards continue along both sides.

delta.desc: The right side of the residence shows the side wall, front lawn, and the detached rear structure|A wood fence encloses the rear yard|The paved driveway and sidewalk are visible at the front|Neighboring homes sit on adjacent lots.

considerations: Vehicle access is provided by a paved driveway from Winchester Ave to the front of the house. A second paved way is visible behind the detached rear structure. The site is a compact single-family lot in a dense residential grid near commercial properties to the south. Side yards are narrow. The wood fence encloses the rear yard. Neighboring houses sit close on all sides.
clarifications: Does the rear paved way provide vehicle access to the detached structure, and is it a public alley? Are there any gates in the rear fence? Is there an entrance from the detached structure into the rear yard? Does the front driveway continue past the house, or does it end at the front? Are doors on the detached structure secured during normal hours?
